written: 2026-09-23, after the MCP handshake (no provider call) and before any Jev call through evaluate; the municipal gold labels are the sealed labels_A/B.json (sha256 in jev-test/muni/results/seal.json)
binary: itsmostafa/typesafe-mcp release v0.4.4, evaluate-darwin-arm64.tar.gz, sha256 c3fa4ff1... checked against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt; run as `evaluate mcp` with a clean env: TYPESAFE_API_KEY = the user's Vercel AI Gateway key, TYPESAFE_BASE_URL = local logging proxy -> https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/typesafe; model passed per call: typesafe-ai/jev

E1_equivalence.chunks: first chunk in jev-test/muni/chunks.json order of each kind: French agreed-content, German agreed-content, agreed-junk
E1_equivalence.calls: each chunk once through evaluate (state = {passage: {page_title, heading, text}} and the 11 M1 questions, exactly as run_muni.py) and once directly to the same Vercel route (same body)
E1_equivalence.metrics: max |dp| evaluate vs direct-now (wrapper effect); max |dp| direct-now vs the earlier M1 answers (model drift or nondeterminism)

E2_items_batch.call: one evaluate call with items = all 75 chunks (id -> {passage: {...}}), no state, the 11 M1 questions verbatim
E2_items_batch.ops_metrics: HTTP requests seen by the proxy, peak concurrency, status counts, re-sends of the same body and the wait before each, items in errors, wall time, median upstream latency of 200s
E2_items_batch.quality_metrics: max and mean |dp| vs the M1 answers; M1's rules R1/R2 re-scored on E2 answers with the same gold (descriptive: tells whether the {item: ...} wrapping changes topic quality)

E3_guidance_design.rationale: the server instructions say: one narrow judgment per question, name the condition to test, include a no-match option in a choice when nothing may fit
E3_guidance_design.call: one evaluate call with items = all 75 chunks, no state, one choice question

question.instructions: Which of the listed topics does the passage's own content in `item.passage` concern? Pick the single best match.
question.criteria: the 10 categories as '<label>: <description>' verbatim from registry/categories.py (same text as M1) plus none_of_these: 'The passage's own content concerns none of these topics'

E3_guidance_design.decision_rule: predicted = {choice} unless choice is none_of_these (then no topic); no confidence threshold
E3_guidance_design.scoring: same gold pairs and exclusions as score_muni.py; precision and recall overall, random/targeted, German/French; exploratory: agreed-content vs agreed-junk chunks, and how many agreed-junk chunks get none_of_these; compared with E2 (same {item: ...} wrapping) and M1
E3_guidance_design.descriptive_only: the same metrics when predictions with choice confidence < 0.3 and < 0.5 are dropped

not_tested: multi-topic tagging (no gold chunk has two topics); dates; score type; min_confidence (not in the v0.4.4 tool schema)
